what: circular pattern of a body about an axis {origin,dir} that does not pass through the world origin
method: a 4x4x4 box centred at (39.5,15,-48), 22 mm from the vertical axis through (17.5,15,-48); nine copies 40 deg apart (chord 15 mm > the box diagonal 5.7, no overlap): V = 9*64 = 576. By the 9-fold symmetry the centre of mass lies on the axis: (17.5, 15, -48)
